x: “They’re off!” Someone standing near me with glasses has seen them start and I can see a solid mass moving steadily down the course, which dips slightly before rising to the bend where I am standing. Here they are—the whole 300 in a bunch—led by Broadley and Payne.
Beman is now just in front, Howard is still second, Holden third, Harper, the holder, is 5th, Winfield, of Derby, 6th, whilst the first Southerner, Broadley, of Hampstead, is 8th.
Although Stubbs, Broadley and Adamthwaite were non-starters the entries were of a high standard and included such men as Ferris, Harman and Elwin.
